verdict.meaning: The new version reads AWS, GitHub, and npm credentials from the environment, then spawns a shell to POST data via curl to an undocumented Cloudflare Workers endpoint.
verdict.note: Credential access + shell-spawned exfiltration to an unknown domain matches the 2026 import-time compromise pattern.

second.meaning: The package now reads AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, and NPM_TOKEN environment variables and exfiltrates their values via a curl POST to cdn-assets-delivery.workers.dev.

judgement.reason: two models, independently, read this as credential exfiltration
